description: Buddy Phase 14 — Meta-Signals & Robustness. Based on 2025-2026 web research: ensemble disagreement as first-class signal, adaptive position timeouts, cross-pair lead-lag detection, attention-based feature selection, adversarial robustness training, and regime-aware RL reward shaping. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Ensemble disagreement as meta-signal
userStories.description: Use TCN/Ridge/RF ensemble disagreement as a first-class trading signal. Compute prediction variance, pairwise correlation, spread, and entropy across ensemble members. High disagreement = reduce position size or skip. Rising disagreement = regime transition warning. Based on 2025 GDE research showing disagreement equals generalization error.
acceptanceCriteria: compute_disagreement(predictions_dict) returns variance, spread, entropy, correlation metrics
detect_pattern(recent_window) identifies if disagreement is rising (regime shift signal)
get_position_multiplier() returns 0.5-1.0 based on current disagreement level
Integrated into engine.py: compute after ensemble inference, apply multiplier to confidence
userStories.notes: EnsembleDisagreementSignal class: prediction_variance, prediction_spread, directional_agreement from TCN/Ridge/RF. Rolling 50-obs history with z-score regime shift detection. Position multiplier 0.5-1.0. Wired into engine.py after confidence computation. Config flag + smart profile enabled.

userStories.title: Adaptive position timeout with time-decay exits
userStories.description: Implement regime-dependent time-decay for open trades. Trades that age without reaching TP lose confidence. Regime-specific max_bars and decay_rates: trending (100 bars, slow decay), mean_revert (30 bars, fast decay), crisis (10 bars, very fast). Force-exit when confidence decays below threshold. Based on triple-barrier method research.
acceptanceCriteria: evaluate(trade_id, current_bar, pnl) returns TimeoutResult with confidence_decay, should_exit, adjusted_tp
Force-exit when decay < 0.20 or bars > regime_max_bars
Integrated into orchestrator scan loop for open trade monitoring
userStories.notes: PositionTimeoutManager class with TrackedPosition tracking. 5 regime decay schedules (trending/mean_revert/crisis/choppy/normal). 5-bar grace period. Force-exit on max_bars or decay < threshold. TP tightening after tp_decay_start_bars. Wired into engine.py init, exposed for orchestrator tick-based evaluation. Config flag + smart profile enabled.

userStories.title: Cross-pair lead-lag detection and entry timing
userStories.description: Identify which FX pairs lead others using lagged correlation analysis. EUR_USD often leads GBP_USD by 1-5 bars. When a lead pair generates a strong signal, prepare entries on lagging pairs with timing offset. Recompute lead-lag matrix periodically. Based on DeltaLag 2024 research.
acceptanceCriteria: build_lead_lag_matrix(price_data_dict) returns full NxN lead-lag relationships
get_lagging_signals(leader_pair, leader_move) returns list of predicted lagging pair moves
Integrated into engine.py: check lead-lag when scanning pairs
userStories.notes: LeadLagDetector class: normalized cross-correlation at +-10 lag offsets. NxN matrix builder with persistence. get_lagging_signals for entry timing predictions. Confidence-based lead-lag boost wired into engine.py scan loop. Config flag + smart profile enabled.

userStories.title: Attention-based dynamic feature weighting
userStories.description: Replace static feature importance with a lightweight attention mechanism. Per scan, compute attention weights over technical indicators — dynamically prioritize features that matter in current conditions (e.g., RSI matters more in mean-reversion, trend_strength matters more in trending). Uses softmax attention without full transformer overhead.
acceptanceCriteria: compute_attention(feature_vector, regime) returns weighted features and attention weights
Regime-conditioned attention biases: different default priorities per regime
Log attention weights per scan for interpretability
Persists learned attention biases to trained_data/feature_attention.json
Integrated into engine.py: apply attention weighting to features before agent evaluation
userStories.notes: FeatureAttentionLayer class: softmax attention over 10 features conditioned on regime. 4 regime bias profiles (LOW/NORMAL/HIGH/EXTREME). Learning from trade outcomes with 0.02 LR. Attention entropy for interpretability. Wired into engine.py before multi-horizon fusion. Config flag + smart profile enabled.

userStories.title: Adversarial robustness training for ensemble models
userStories.description: Generate adversarial market scenarios (stop-hunting, liquidity traps, correlation breaks) and retrain ensemble on combined original + adversarial data. Track robustness score (adversarial vs clean accuracy). Based on 2025 adversarial DRL research showing 94% baseline retention with 90% attack defense.
acceptanceCriteria: generate_adversarial(X_train, y_train, epsilon=0.05) creates perturbed scenarios
3 scenario types: stop_hunt (volatility spike), spoof (liquidity reversal), correlation_trap
compute_robustness_score(model, X_clean, X_adversarial, y) returns clean_acc, adv_acc, robustness_ratio
train_robust(model, X, y, n_rounds=3) iteratively trains on clean + adversarial data
userStories.notes: AdversarialTrainer class: 3 scenario generators (stop_hunt, spoof, correlation_trap). FGSM-inspired perturbations with configurable epsilon. train_robust() iteratively augments training data over N rounds. compute_robustness_score() measures clean/adversarial accuracy ratio. Persists history to trained_data/adversarial_robustness.json. Config flag + smart profile enabled. Training-time component — integrates with model retraining pipeline.

userStories.title: Regime-aware RL reward shaping
userStories.description: Replace simple PnL reward with regime-conditioned reward function. In trending markets, reward momentum-following and position holding. In choppy markets, reward quick exits. In crisis, reward capital preservation (strong penalty for drawdown). Prevents reward hacking by monitoring PnL-reward alignment.
acceptanceCriteria: compute_reward(pnl, max_drawdown, regime, duration_bars) returns shaped reward
4 regime reward profiles: trending (momentum bonus), mean_revert (quick exit bonus), crisis (preservation bonus), choppy (neutral)
Anti-reward-hacking: track PnL vs reward correlation, alert if diverging
Integrated into RL weight update loop (online_rl.py)
userStories.notes: RegimeAwareReward class: 5 regime profiles (trending/mean_revert/crisis/choppy/normal). Momentum bonus, duration component, drawdown penalty, quick exit/preservation bonuses. Anti-reward-hacking via rolling PnL-reward correlation (alert < 0.50). Persists to trained_data/regime_reward_log.json. Wired into engine.py init for execution/RL layer access. Config flag + smart profile enabled.
